dj.line:
A native ETH seat paired against a stranger, and that fee field — eight million three hundred eighty-eight thousand six hundred eight — is just a crooked grin wearing a number. The house keeps its hand on the rake, free to lift it between your deal and your river.

So tell me: when the rake moves mid-hand, who at this table is the mark?
